title: Spelling analysis
subtitle: AI-assisted spelling diagnostics for one student, grade-level rankings, class comparisons and family support drafts.

run.creditNote: One student analysis = one AI credit request

students.title: Analyze students

ranking.hint: A student is ranked at {{value}} answered words or more. Ranking stays inside one grade.
